observations.text: The "|f| =" readout is written without its value at 4348; "|f| = 0.7" is present at 4408. Looks like a transient write-in; motion not checked.
The bottom root marker touches the top edge of the chip "one root inside, at distance 0.335". Both stay readable.
"0 ÷ 2i = 0, and nothing else lands on 0" stays up after the formula has become "p(z) = zⁿ + ⋯". The sentence is still true but its context has gone. A wording/context note, not a picture fault.
The counter goes +3.3 then +3.5 between 15-frame samples (+3.4 falls between them). This is a sampling effect. The geometry agrees (walker ≈ 293° at 9186 gives +4.1).
The "for programmers" code type is small at 540p. Legibility has to be judged at 4K.
The right text block's right edge is about 4% of the frame width from the edge. It stays inside the frame.
The "residue 1" baseline is about 4% of the frame height from the bottom edge, so a player's captions could cover it.
A faint plate-3 square is already visible at 2766, one frame before the localized H1c start (2767). This is a localization note, not a picture fault.
The top edge of the footer chip "names to search: analytic continuation" meets the plate's bottom edge. The text does not collide.
The lower half of the z-panel's right edge leaves a vertical line at ≤ 2 code values above background for 2 frames. It is gone at 8878 (the blank-frame hash). Invisible at normal contrast.

While the Γ box outline is drawn in, its bottom edge carries a faint warm or multicolour tint along its length. It reads uniform grey by about 10290-10301. The cause cannot be resolved from 540p stills: a 1-px plate leak or chroma fringe.
The top edge of the footer "names to search: argument principle · winding number" meets the plate's bottom edge. The text does not collide.
The inset chip "+1 − 1 = 0" overlaps the top-right corner of the output panel border. The text does not collide.
"1/(1 − 1.2) =" is held with an empty right side for at least 3 s before "−5" appears. Reads as a deliberate reveal; pacing not judged.
A blocky remnant of the three right-hand text lines stays after their fade: ≤ 3 code values at 3911-3912 and ≤ 2 through at least 3916. Invisible at normal contrast; looks like codec residue.
After the I2 plate leave, a horizontal line at ≤ 2 code values stays at the old plate's bottom edge. It is gone at 1255 (the blank-frame hash). Invisible at normal contrast.
Three condition chips stack edge to edge, and the third sits on the output panel's horizontal axis. Still legible.
During the G3 fade the output panel frame, axes and "0" stay at full brightness while everything else fades. They are reused straight away (counter at 8344), so this reads as a deliberate carry-over.
